Customs Act 2023: Section 25(1) of this Act serves as the enabling legal provision under which the Government is empowered to issue notifications, including those related to the repeal of earlier orders.
National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue exercises its regulatory authority to formally repeal previously issued customs notifications.
S.R.O. 164-AIN/2012: This specific customs notification, originally issued in June 2012, is hereby officially repealed and rescinded by the current order.
